name: Tommy Thompson
desc: 19th United States Secretary of Health and Human Services; 42nd Governor of Wisconsin (born 1941)

offices.t: United States Secretary of Health and Human Services

summary: Tommy George Thompson (born November 19, 1941) is an American politician who served as the 19th United States secretary of health and human services from 2001 to 2005 under President George W. Bush. A member of the Republican Party, he was the 42nd governor of Wisconsin from 1987 to 2001 and Republican floor leader in the Wisconsin State Assembly from 1981 to 1987. Thompson is the longest-serving governor in Wisconsin history and is the only person to be elected to the office four times.
